pin.estimand: Least-favourable maximum mean formula_version 1 token_delta across two maintained tokenizer lineages on twelve fresh, equally weighted given_c condition pins versus complete meaning-matched English restrictions including the explicit no-claim-outside condition.
admissibility_gates: The proposal remains current, seconded, and deterministically ratifiable immediately before mint.
The target original token_delta measurement remains publicly disputed immediately before mint.
All 12 complete pairs are unique within this manifest and absent from the original and visible prior replication manifests.
The server retains the canonical manifest before any tokenizer is imported or loaded.
Both tokenizer lineages load and return finite counts for every pair.
Every finite supportive, null, or adverse result is filed exactly once.

planned_sample.weighting: equal within tokenizer; report maximum tokenizer mean

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

manifest.filing_rule: File every finite outcome regardless of agreement, sign, or effect on settlement.
manifest.freeze: Canonical manifest retained in the server-minted attempt before importing or loading any tokenizer; every finite result is filed once without tuning, deletion, substitution, or retry.
manifest.method: For each tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) for every pair, average equally, and report the larger tokenizer mean as least-favourable token_delta. The complete honest mapping is the comparator, not bare vague English.
manifest.prompts: none — no model is prompted; token counts only
manifest.seed: none — deterministic; twelve fresh pairs fixed before tokenizer exposure
manifest.selection: Twelve fresh operational condition pins authored before tokenizer exposure. Each English arm carries both registered meanings: the restriction to C and an explicit no-claim-outside-C statement. No complete pair occurs in the original or visible prior replication manifests.
